claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Summary of Changes

**Core Implementation:**
- **src/cycles.js**: Added `CYCLE.WEEK = 'weekly'` and updated the billing cycle logic
  - Weekly plans calculate monthly cost as `price × 52 ÷ 12` (using `MONTHS_PER_CHARGE` of `12/52`)
  - `nextCharge()` function now handles weekly cycles by adding 7 days at a time
  
- **bin/subtrack.js**: Added support for `--every week` flag
  - Updated USAGE text to show `--every month|year|week`
  - Added "week"/"weekly" mappings to the EVERY object
  - Updated error message for invalid cycle flags
  - Added `SHARE_PER_MONTH` entry for weekly: `52/12` (for accurate total calculations)

- **src/export.js**: Updated CSV export to handle weekly cycles
  - Added `weekly: 12/52` to MONTHS mapping for correct monthly cost calculation

- **src/renewals.js**: Fixed renewal sorting bug
  - Changed sorting from `when` (short label) to `date` (YYYY-MM-DD format) for correct chronological ordering across month boundaries

**Test Coverage:**
- Added 3 new unit tests to `test/cycles.test.js`:
  - Weekly plan cost calculation (price × 52 ÷ 12 per month)
  - Weekly charge dates (every 7 days)
  - Weekly cycle inclusion in CYCLES list

- Added 3 new integration tests to `test/cli.test.js`:
  - Adding a weekly plan via CLI
  - Weekly plan renewal listings
  - Weekly plan CSV export

**All 39 tests pass** ✓

The feature now works exactly as specified:
- `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` creates a weekly subscription
- Monthly cost is calculated and rounded correctly (€259.56 for €59.90/week)
- Weekly plans charge every 7 days from their first charge
- `subtrack renewals` lists them like any other plan
